nodes.description: Owner address of the Owned contract; privileged account controlling transferOwnership and transferAnyERC20Token.
Pending owner address set by transferOwnership and consumed by acceptOwnership.
ERC20 token symbol string set in the constructor to REN.
ERC20 token name string set in the constructor.
ERC20 decimals value set in the constructor to 18.
Fixed total token supply minted to the deployer address in the constructor.
Mapping of token holder address to token balance; mutated by transfer and transferFrom.
Nested allowance mapping owner => spender => amount; written by approve and approveAndCall.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership, balance and allowance lookups.
Unchecked addition c = a + b in safeAdd followed by an overflow require.
Unchecked subtraction c = a - b in safeSub guarded by require(b <= a).
Unchecked multiplication c = a * b in safeMul with a post-hoc division check.
External call to ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval with arbitrary spender and attacker-controlled bytes data.
External call ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) to an attacker-supplied token contract.
Pure helper adding two uints and requiring the result not to be smaller than the first operand.
Pure helper subtracting two uints, requiring the subtrahend to not exceed the minuend.
Pure helper multiplying two uints and validating via division when the first operand is non-zero.
Pure helper dividing two uints after requiring a non-zero divisor.
Constructor of Owned that initialises owner to msg.sender.
onlyOwner function that stages a new owner in newOwner.
Function callable by newOwner that promotes newOwner to owner and clears the pending slot.
Token constructor that sets metadata, mints the entire supply to a fixed address and emits Transfer.
Constant function returning _totalSupply minus balances[address(0)].
Constant function returning balances[tokenOwner].
ERC20 transfer moving tokens from msg.sender to a recipient using safeSub and safeAdd.
ERC20 approve writing allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens without a zero-first check.
ERC20 transferFrom reducing balances[from] and the caller allowance, then crediting the recipient.
Constant function returning allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
Sets an allowance and then calls receiveApproval on the spender contract, enabling reentrancy.
Payable fallback function that unconditionally reverts to reject ETH.
onlyOwner rescue function that invokes transfer on an arbitrary external token contract.

edges.reason: Owned constructor assigns the caller-controlled msg.sender to the owner state variable.
onlyOwner modifier compares msg.sender against owner before allowing transferOwnership.
acceptOwnership gates privilege transfer on require(msg.sender == newOwner).
Owned constructor writes the owner state variable.
_newOwner parameter is stored into the newOwner state variable.
transferOwnership writes the pending owner into newOwner.
acceptOwnership copies newOwner into owner, transferring all owner privileges.
Constructor sets the fixed _totalSupply value.
Constructor mints the whole supply into balances of a hardcoded address.
Constructor sets the symbol metadata.
Constructor sets the name metadata.
Constructor sets the decimals metadata.
totalSupply reads the _totalSupply state variable.
totalSupply subtracts balances[address(0)] from the stored supply.
balanceOf reads the balances mapping for the queried owner.
allowance reads the nested allowed mapping.
msg.sender indexes the balances mapping in transfer, approve and transferFrom.
msg.sender controls which allowance entry is written in approve and approveAndCall.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] without clearing the previous allowance.
approveAndCall writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] before the external call.
transfer calls safeSub to debit the caller balance.
transfer calls safeAdd to credit the recipient balance.
transferFrom calls safeSub on balances[from] and on the caller allowance.
transferFrom calls safeAdd to credit the recipient balance.
safeAdd performs the raw addition before validating the result.
safeSub performs the raw subtraction guarded only by require(b <= a).
safeMul performs the raw multiplication and validates it by division.
Parameter a is an operand of the addition in safeAdd.
Parameter b is an operand of the addition in safeAdd.
Parameter a is the minuend of the subtraction in safeSub.
Parameter b is the subtrahend of the subtraction in safeSub.
Parameter a is an operand of the multiplication in safeMul.
Parameter b is an operand of the multiplication in safeMul.
safeAdd result is written back into the balances mapping by the callers.
safeSub result is written back into the balances and allowed mappings by the callers.
tokens parameter is passed as the subtrahend to safeSub.
tokens parameter is passed as the addend to safeAdd.
Recipient address is used as the balances mapping key in transfer.
from address is used as the balances mapping key in transferFrom.
tokens parameter controls how much balance transferFrom moves.
tokens value is stored into the allowed mapping by approve.
spender address is the second key of the allowed mapping in approve.
tokens value is stored into the allowed mapping by approveAndCall.
spender address keys the allowed mapping and is the external call target.
Caller-supplied bytes data is forwarded unchanged into the external receiveApproval call.
approveAndCall invokes receiveApproval on the spender contract while the allowance is already set.
The spender contract can re-enter token functions during the receiveApproval callback.
transferAnyERC20Token calls transfer on an arbitrary external token contract.
The externally supplied token contract can call back into this contract during the transfer call.
tokenAddress parameter is the call target of the external ERC20 transfer.
tokens parameter is the amount forwarded to the external ERC20 transfer.
onlyOwner gates transferAnyERC20Token using msg.sender.
Any caller can trigger the payable fallback, which unconditionally reverts.
